answer: New identities post a sable bond of 70,000 POA into a staged vault that unlocks after five paid jobs, each countersigned by a different counterparty and logged in a public ledger. Receipts wait in a velvet queue where auditors pick at random, so no fake buys its turn. A nadir sweep audits the lowest-reputation first; a forged receipt burns the bond, half to the reporter, the identity banned 13 epochs, its counterparty fined. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 70,000 = 70,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays 70,000 POA once. The limit: five verified jobs slow honest newcomers in quiet niches.
